discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: Topological insulators are a field-defining condensed-matter discovery: Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall state in 2005, and Molenkamp's group confirmed it in HgTe quantum wells in 2007. All three have already won major awards that often come before a Nobel, such as the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver Buckley prizes. After the 2024 machine-learning prize and the 2025 superconducting-circuit prize, the committee may return to a mature condensed-matter topic. The 2016 prize on topological phases does not rule this out: it honored the earlier theory, and this would recognize the material class it led to.
